title: Temperature-dependent particle formation during biomass combustion: a combined spICP-TOFMS and magnetic study
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00319B, Paper
Calvel Sélène, Isambert Aude, Tharaud Mickael, Cuss Chad W., Carlut Julie, Coudour Bruno, Benedetti Marc F.
Wildfire intensity shapes inorganic nanoparticle formation and mobility. Higher combustion temperatures transform iron oxides, boost magnetic signatures, and shift particles from Fe-rich to Mn-dominated, offering new proxies for post-fire environmental assessment.
